cards.title: Second Baby Parenting: What I Forgot
cards.body: A parent reflects on having a second child and realizing how much she'd forgotten about babies—from feeding to teething to diaper changes. With her mother's help managing the practical aspects, she's rediscovering memories of her own relaxed childhood.

cards.title: Should AI Help With Parenting?
cards.body: Tech companies now offer eye-movement trackers, personalized podcasts, and optimized nap predictions for parents. The question is whether these tools solve real problems or create unnecessary complexity in an already demanding job.

cards.title: The '18 Summers' Parenting Trend
cards.body: The popular trend of maximizing every summer with planned activities treats school holidays as a 'making memories' exercise. Critics argue that long, unstructured days are actually the point of summer break.

cards.title: 5 Reasons Your Emotions Matter as Parent
cards.body: Your emotional life directly impacts your parenting and your connection with your children. Understanding and managing your feelings creates a stronger family foundation.

cards.title: Quiet Children May Be Most Overwhelmed
cards.body: Children who withdraw silently during stress often go unnoticed compared to those who act out loudly. Adults can easily miss signs of distress in quiet kids who need just as much support.

cards.title: Racial Socialization as Survival Strategy
cards.body: Black families face unique challenges requiring intentional conversations about race and identity. Racial socialization is a critical survival and thriving strategy for Black youth navigating the world.

cards.title: When Adult Children Stop Contact
cards.body: Estranged adult children hear repetitive criticisms: 'You didn't try hard enough,' 'You're too sensitive,' 'You won't forgive.' Understanding what these messages overlook helps families navigate difficult separations.

cards.title: Financial Rescues Create Family Patterns
cards.body: When parents repeatedly bail out panicking adult children, urgency itself becomes embedded in family dynamics. Breaking the rescue cycle requires understanding how financial emergencies reinforce unhealthy patterns.

cards.title: Motherhood and Women's Mental Health
cards.body: The Lindsay Clancy trial reveals societal judgments about motherhood, mental health, and what defines a 'good mother.' The case exposes how we frame maternal struggles and responsibility.
